# pbs_user (Data Source)

Reads a Proxmox Backup Server user. Reading another user than the one the provider signs in as needs Sys.Audit on /access/users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_user" "pve" {
  userid = "pve@pbs"
}

# Warn when the user Proxmox VE backs up as can no longer sign in, or is set
# to stop being able to: its backups would start failing.
check "pve_user_can_sign_in" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_user.pve.enable && data.pbs_user.pve.expire == 0
    error_message = "The PBS user ${data.pbs_user.pve.userid} is disabled or has an expiry date."
  }
}

output "pve_user_contact" {
  value = coalesce(data.pbs_user.pve.email, "no email address")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `userid` (String) User ID of the user to read, such as `alice@pbs`.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `email` (String) Email address; null when there is none.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the user may sign in.
- `expire` (Number) When the account expires, in seconds since the Unix epoch; `0` for never.
- `firstname` (String) First name; null when there is none.
- `lastname` (String) Last name; null when there is none.
